beats.say: Walter Koenig was one of only two actors auditioning for Chekov.
That is two people, fewer than a standard car seat row.
Producers cast him almost immediately for a surprising visual reason.
He looked just like Davy Jones from the Monkees.
Because Koenig was thirty and his hair was receding, designers made a mop top wig.
He landed an iconic role entirely because of a pop star look.
